text:
zoe: Heads-up team: I'm starting a small docs cleanup for function/tool calling examples. Goal: make three tiny, linkable snippets (invoke + schema + fallback) so SDK READMEs can reference exact examples.

mike: Good plan. Can we keep each snippet under 20 lines and include both minimal JSON schema and one sample valid output?

zoe: Yep. Keep them short. Use stable anchors like #snippet-invoke, #snippet-schema, #snippet-fallback. No generated hashes.

tara: I can take the schema piece. I'll include a short shim pattern for when a tool returns extra fields (example tool payload: {"id": 42, "result": "OK", "meta": {"duration_ms": 120}} and schema only expects id/result). Will show a tiny destructuring shim.

mike: I'll do the split and anchor headings. My PR will only touch headings, code fences, and add the <Snippet lang="ts" copy /> wrapper for TS examples.

ci-bot: deploy-preview available: https://deploy-preview.redwood/docs/toolcall-snippets-4509 (lint: passed) :white_check_mark:

zoe: Add a one-line note on parse fallback order: strict JSON -> tolerant JSON -> regex fallback. We want that visible under the fallback snippet.

tara: Also include a tiny migration note: "If you are on different SDK major versions, use the snippet labeled for your version." I'll list 3.x and 4.x invoke forms.

mike: Timeline: open PRs by Friday EOD. Prefix PRs with `docs: toolcall snippets`.

leo: I'll add a tiny CLI test that demonstrates the fallback (show input, failing strict parse, and the fallback result). Keeps QA simple.

zoe: Perfect. Tag me on PRs and add a one-line release note in the PR body. If we find cross-page broken links, escalate and run site-wide link-checker.

mike: Opening my split/anchors PR now.

tara: Schema PR later today.

leo: Fallback test PR by tomorrow.

zoe: Thanks everyone. Short, scannable snippets only — we don't want to bloat the page. :thumbsup:
